meta.description: US-02-JUANPABLO — Receives Supabase health_records webhook events, classifies symptom severity via DeepSeek LLM (Low/Medium/High/Critical), and routes urgent Telegram alerts to farm owners for High/Critical findings. Expected Supabase webhook payload: { type, table, schema, record: { id, farm_id, owner_id, production_type, animal_count_affected, symptoms_text, reported_at, reported_by } }

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: $json.llm_model, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, temperature: 0.1, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.prompt_system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.prompt_user }] } }}
